description: Municipal Building Energy Usage is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. This data set contains energy use data from 2009-2014 for 139 municipally operated buildings. Metrics include: Site & Source EUI, annual electricity, natural gas and district steam consumption, greenhouse gas emissions and energy cost. Weather-normalized data enable building performance comparisons over time, despite unusual weather events. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are EUI, address, building, building energy use, conservation. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-06-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
